purpose: Find an already exposed, read-only USB-C attachment indication in the running Gemian boot without reading controller registers.

observed.fusb_platform_device_status_files: No controller-specific status attribute in either platform device's top-level regular files.

classification: The inspected Gemian class and platform interfaces provide no identified independent USB-C attachment or VBUS indication. The available OTG switch is not established as an independent physical signal. No I2C, debugfs, PMIC or other controller-register read was attempted.
limits: Only the named sysfs directories and top-level regular files were enumerated; this does not prove no other software interface exists. Cable destination was not confirmed.
